llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金的SLM工艺与热处理，与生物医用植入物的应力遮挡、疲劳和骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no stress shielding, no fatigue testing relevant to implants, and no surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理模式对SLM镍基高温合金微观组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备试样并进行不同热处理，通过显微分析和力学测试表征。
summary_zh.result: 发现热处理可显著改变晶粒尺寸和析出相，进而影响硬度和拉伸性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、XRD和力学试验验证微观结构与性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how different heat treatment modes affect the microstructure and mechanical properties of nickel-based superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM and subjected to various heat treatments, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered grain size and precipitate morphology, leading to changes in hardness and tensile properties.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural observation (SEM, XRD) and mechanical tests (hardness, tensile) were used to validate the relationship.

papers.title: Broadband 3D-Printed Polarizer Based on Metallic Transverse Electro-Magnetic Unit-Cells
papers.abstract: This article presents a 3-D polarizing screen that converts linear to circular polarization in a broadband frequency range. The conceived unit cells are fully metallic and based on structures that support transverse electromagnetic modes. Such cells have been specially conceived to be manufactured through metal 3-D printing based on selective laser melting. This is the first time that a polarizing structure presents such a broadband behavior without the use of dielectric materials. In addition, this is the first successful proof of concept of additive manufacturing in the context of metallic periodic surfaces, which is enabled by the use of a codesign approach. The present proposal is validated through the design and manufacturing of a prototype operating in K- and Ka-bands. Successful experimental results are reported.

summary_en.motivation: To realize a broadband polarizing screen without dielectric materials using additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Metallic unit cells supporting transverse electromagnetic modes are designed and fabricated via selective laser melting 3D printing.
summary_en.result: A prototype operating in K- and Ka-bands demonstrates successful broadband linear-to-circular polarization conversion.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements on the fabricated prototype confirm the polarizer's performance.
